Good morning. Pumpkin spice season is officially here, and so is earnings season. Let's get into it.

MARKETS

The Fed holds steady, stocks don't

The Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged on Wednesday, but signalled two cuts before year-end. The S&P 500 rose 1.4%, its best day since August.

Chair Powell said inflation is "moving in the right direction" while the labor market cools gradually.

Oil slips on supply news

Brent crude fell 3% after OPEC+ said it would raise output in November, according to Bloomberg.

TECH

Apple's chip team loses another leader

Apple's head of silicon engineering is leaving for a startup, the third senior departure this year. The company said the transition will not affect next year's roadmap.
